description: A one-line braceless `else if` chain keeps every arm and its structure, and a dangling `else` binds to the NEAREST `if` (S462). Pre-fix the chain's middle `if` became an unconditional sibling and the final `else` vanished, and `if (a) if (b) x else y` lost `y`.
rationale: §17.6.1 standard if-statement semantics: an `else` belongs to the nearest unmatched `if`.
